test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 55

questions.question: A shopkeeper lists the price of a fan at 50% above its cost price and offers a 31% discount on its list price. If he earns a profit of ₹112, then what is the list price (in ₹) of the fan?
A store offers a promotion "Buy 45, get 15 free." What is the net percentage discount?
A cylinder of volume 450 cm3 is superimposed by a cone of the same base and the same height. The volume of the shape formed by the combination of the cylinder and cone is:
If the ratio of two numbers is 8 : 6, and their HCF is 35, then their LCM is:
In what ratio must a grocer mix two varieties of rice costing ₹173 and ₹101 per kg, respectively, to get a mixture of rice worth ₹119 per kg?

Anil has ₹1,248 with him. He divided it among his sons Ashok and Raj and asked them to invest it at 8% rate of interest compounded annually. It was seen that Ashok and Raj got same amount after 16 and 17 years respectively. How much (in ₹) did Anil give to Raj?
A and B start a race of 100 m. A runs at 10 m/s and B at 8 m/s. How much head start (in meters) should B be given so that both finish at the same time?
A and B complete a work in 2 days. If A alone can do it in 4 days, then B alone can do 80-times of the same work in ________ days.
The average of 20 numbers is found to be 27. Later on it was found that two numbers 18 and 12 were wrongly copied as 5 and 5. The correct average is:
If ₹694 is divided among 299 children such that each girl and each boy receives ₹3 and ₹2, respectively, then how many boys are there?
In what time (in months) will ₹4,800 fetch an interest of ₹480 at 5% per annum simple interest?

Girish scored 580 marks in an examination and was 65 marks short of 86% of the maximum marks. In the same examination, his friend scored 405 marks. What is the percentage of marks scored by his friend?
A shopkeeper lists the price of a fan at 60% above its cost price and offers a 35% discount on its list price. If he earns a profit of ₹73, then what is the list price (in ₹) of the fan?
After decreasing 75% in the actual cost price, the reduced cost price of an article is ₹1,040. The actual cost price of the article (in ₹) is:
A man buys 12 identical articles for a total of ₹16. If he sells each of them for ₹2.6, then his profit percentage will be ______%.

A person started a business with an investment ₹80,000.  He got 25% of profit in first year.  He reinvested 80% of his profit.  He got 8% loss in second year.  What is the percentage of  profit at the end of 2nd year on his starting investment?
Evaluate: 33 ÷ 11 × 5 - 3 × 4

Ginny travels from point A to point B, a distance of 150 km. On her way to B, she covers the first half of the distance at a speed of 50 km/h and the second half at 75 km/h. On her return journey from B to A, she travels at a constant speed of 60 km/h. What is her average speed (in km/h) for the entire round trip?

Vipul invests a sum of ₹6600 and Vijay invests a sum of ₹10600 at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If, at the end of 6 years, Vijay gets ₹960 more interest than Vipul, then find the rate of interest per annum (in percentage).
The total surface area (in m2) of a cube, each of whose edges measures 297 m, is:
